title: 第7章 请你吃
content_zh:
第7章 请你吃
在许青这里观察搏斗区域环境时，随着四周观席上的嚣嚷声，斗兽场内，方才许青一行人走过的大门处，轰的一声，一扇巨大的木门落下。
重重的砸在了地面上，掀起尘土飞扬。
这声音，好似吹响了号角，使得四周的拾荒者更为兴奋。
许青更是注意到在正前方的顶部高台，有一个身穿锦袍的中年，在一群人的伴随下，坐在了最上首的位置。
因距离较远，样子有些模糊。
但显然此人的身份不一般。
距离这么远，许青都能感受到对方身上的灵能波动极为浓郁，超出他见过的所有。
这让许青警惕的同时，内心也有了猜测，此人大概率就是这营地的营主了。
因为在对方的身边，许青看到了昨日的那个三撇胡正佝着身子，似在小心的汇报。
而随着营主的落座，那三撇胡站在高台，向着下方打了个手势。
很快斗兽场边缘，又有一扇木门开启，阵阵凶兽的嘶吼咆哮声，没有了木门的阻拦，更为清晰的传出。
随着声音出现的，是一群拾荒者。
他们分成四个小队，每个小队三人，各自抬着巨大的铁笼，慢慢的走出。
铁笼内，凶兽咆哮，四处扑跃，仿佛要撕开牢笼。
许青飞速看去，扫过这四个铁笼。
看到其内有两只巨狼，一大一小，但都牙齿锋利，全身漆黑，双目透出血色。
更有大量的涎水从其嘴角落下，看向许青五人时，都露出凶残之意。
还有一头赤色毛发的红熊，粗壮的胳膊超过成人的大腿，神色内满是暴躁之意，不断地摇晃铁笼。
将其抬来的三个拾荒者，都很是吃力。

至于最后一个铁笼内的凶兽，则明显气势上弱了不少。
那是一只长臂猿。
全身长满了脓包，似稍一碰触就会爆开，尤其是它仿佛很痛苦，不断地撞击铁笼，使得脓包不断碎裂，触目惊心。
他们的出现，使得四周观众再次沸腾。
许青身边那两个少年面色瞬间苍白，那小女孩也是目中惊恐极重，哪怕本就是拾荒者的青年，此刻也明显紧张了不少。
“怎么是四个？”许青诧异，看向敞开的木门通道。
就在他看去的一刻，忽然那四个咆哮挣扎的凶兽，竟瞬间安静下来，仿佛被震慑一样。
与此同时，一个比它们所在的牢笼大了近乎一倍的巨大铁笼，被六个拾荒者从那木门内缓缓抬出。
随着铁笼的出现，四周的观众顿时就有人传出惊呼声。
“巨角蟒！！”
“这一次营主竟弄来了一条巨角蟒，不过也是，想来在营主眼中，这玩意也不算什么值钱之物。”
“对这些小崽子来说，这玩意谁抽到谁死，就算是我们在野外遇到，也需要两个人拼命才能将其斩杀。”
那铁笼内存在的凶兽，赫然是一条巨大的蟒蛇。
其身体的粗细堪比成年人的腰部，全身灰黑带着暗纹，那暗纹仔细去看，好似描绘着一座座如角般的山峰。
它一动不动的盘在牢笼内，巨大的头颅微微抬起，黄色的竖瞳带着阴冷，看向外界。
在它的注视下，无论是巨狼还是长臂猿，竟都在颤抖。
唯独那红熊，发出受到刺激时的低吼，看似对抗，可实际上其身体在缓缓后退，直至退到了所在牢笼的边缘。
“千万不要抽到，千万不要抽到……”
许青身后，那两个少年此刻颤抖，都在低声祈祷时，许青的眼睛里却有精芒一闪。
他知道这巨角蟒，曾经在贫民窟时，他看到过城内有人狩猎此蟒抬回来的蟒尸。

当时也听身边经历丰富之人说起过，此蟒力气很大，一旦被其缠绕，巨木都会被其勒断，且蟒皮很厚。
但身体笨拙，速度相对来说不快。
而它的胆，具备很好的药性，对于身体的污染有一定化解，同时蛇肉也很滋补。
想到这里，许青脑海浮现出雷队曾说，喜欢吃蛇。
而蛇，他小时候抓过不少，于是舔了舔嘴唇。
另外他身上的异化点随着修行，越发漆黑，昨日修炼时都隐隐有些刺痛感传出。
许青琢磨着若能吃到这蟒蛇的胆，想来应该会化解很多。
在他盯着巨角蟒凝望时，抽签开始了。
随着三撇胡安排的拾荒者拿着五个竹签过来，每一个竹签上都标注了需与之搏斗的凶兽名字。
青年第一个上前抽取，在看到所抽之物后，他明显松了口气。
随后是那两个少年与小女孩。
前两者祈祷中抽出竹签后，神色都有些苦涩，但那小女孩看着手中的竹签，目中却露出了绝望。
她抽中的正是巨角蟒，而剩下的最后竹签，是那头小狼，这也是五个凶兽里，明显最弱的一个。
许青拿着竹签，眉头微微皱起，沉吟起来。
很快，在拾荒者退下，他们这些试炼人也都被安排在了角落简单拦住后，于四周观战人的欢呼中，第一场试炼开始。
安排出场的，是两个少年中的一个。
他瑟瑟发抖的走出，与他一战的凶兽，是那头粗壮的红熊。
交战的过程很快，那少年根本就不是红熊的对手，在勉强对拼了几次后，被那红熊扑倒，于绝望中，身体被直接撕开。
鲜血四溅，迎来了四周的沸腾，还伴随着懊悔的谩骂。
这一幕，将另一个少年直接吓的身体哆嗦不已，原本应该第二个上场的他，突然高呼要放弃试炼。

于是在嘘声中，许青看着这少年被拾荒者带走，结果如何，不想而知。
第三个，是那个本就是拾荒者的青年。
他抽中的是那头大一些的黑狼，拾荒者的经历，使得他在狠辣上超出普通人。
一场惊心动魄的生死搏斗后，他带着伤势，气喘吁吁的斩杀了那头狼，成为了这一次试炼里，第一个成功者。
大门开启，他捂着胸口，自由的离去。
第四个……则是小女孩。
当关住巨角蟒的铁牢，被人
但就在这时，许青忽然开口。
“我们换一下。”
小女孩一愣，没等反应过来，许青已将自身的竹签与其替换。
抽走刻着巨角蟒的竹签后，他没去在意小女孩感激的目光，向着巨角蟒走去。
随着进入，四周观望的拾荒者，显然之前看到了顺序，此刻纷纷起哄。
但除了赌押他与小女孩之人，旁者不会去在意这种事，他们不会，营主也不会，一切都是自生自灭。
斗兽场内，许青平静的向着铁笼走去，其内的巨角蟒阴冷的看着许青，慢慢的爬出。
粗壮的身体探出铁笼时，鳞片划过笼子的铁杆，发出阵阵刺耳的摩擦声。
动物的本能，让它察觉眼前这个少年，与它平日里遇到的猎物有些不一样。
所以在爬出后，这条巨角蟒没有第一时间发起攻击，而是在铁笼外盘起了阵，头部高高昂起，带着警惕，盯着不断靠近的许青。
这一幕，让四周观众纷纷感兴趣，起哄声也少了一些。
许青神色如常，步步临近，或许是他走入了巨角蟒的攻击范围，也或许是被他气息所刺激，巨角蟒竖着的黄色瞳孔内阴冷之意刹那浓郁，尾巴在地面猛地一敲，传出轰鸣之声。
其身体更是在这声响里，借力猛地冲出，半空中大口张开，狰狞间露出利齿，更散出难闻的腥臭，向着许青，呼啸而来，要将其吞噬。

许青眼睛眯起，冷冷看着飞速临近的巨角蟒，在对方靠近的刹那，他身体一晃避开，没有选择趁机动手，更没去理会从身边穿梭而过的巨大蟒头，而是目露锐利之芒，如猎人一样，密切观察这条蟒蛇的腹部。
在他的观察中，巨角蟒扑空，口中传出低吼，身躯一扭，顿时它的尾巴在后方猛地一甩，一样掀起刺耳的呼啸声，向着许青凶猛抽来。
狩猎的本能，更是让这巨角蟒头部在此刻强行转弯，与尾巴一后一前，好似一个要连在一起的圆形，直奔许青，仿佛要将他缠绕起来。
许青沉默，目光依旧在这巨角蟒的腹部观察，直至蛇尾临近，他右手忽然握拳，在蛇尾抽来的刹那，一拳打去。
海山诀的修炼，虽只是一层，可带给许青的肉身加持，依旧不小，此刻蛇尾被轰击，直接倒卷，使首尾无法连接，而巨角蟒明显有些吃痛，可这不致命的伤痛，使它凶意大涨，红着眼，头颅狠狠撞来，向着许青一口咬去。
但许青却眼睛一凝，有精芒闪耀，他终于找到了想找之处，此刻身体迈步，不退反进，直接就贴近这巨角蟒身躯的中间偏上的区域。
右手握拳用力狠狠打出，一拳，两拳，三拳……
拳拳轰击。
来自许青的冲击力使巨角蟒不断倒退，嘶吼更为强烈，试图将许青缠绕，可许青拳头内蕴含的力量，使它首尾难以碰触。
至于被轰击的腹部，因鳞片相对薄弱，数拳之后，竟被许青打的有些碎裂，血迹渗出，韧性受损。
眼看如此，不等这巨角蟒改变身形，许青眼内冷厉之芒一闪。
他左手立刻抽出绑在小腿的匕首，在匕首寒芒闪耀中，无比迅猛直接刺入巨角蟒的血肉内。
瞬间破入，狠狠一豁。
血水四溅，在这巨角蟒凄厉的嘶音中，其腹部被豁开一道触目惊心的伤口，露出了腔体内的蛇胆。
此蛇很大，但显然有所变异，蛇胆很小，如鸡蛋一样。
许青没有丝毫迟疑，右手抬起一把深入腔体，抓住蛇胆用力一拽，在巨角蟒凄厉的嘶吼中，将其蛇胆生生取出。
鲜血喷洒，淋落沙土。
无视这些血迹，许青拿着蛇胆，目露奇芒，当着四周神色各异拾荒者的面，直接就放在嘴里，一口吞下。
平静的吞咽中，被活活取胆的巨角蟒，痛的疯狂挣扎，嘶吼凄厉，身躯用力拍打地面掀起尘土，似想要宣泄剧痛。
头颅更是猛烈的向许青撞来，红着的双眼透出癫狂，大口张开到极致，仿佛要将许青彻底吞噬。

许青冷眼看去，在对方临近的一瞬，身体蓦然跃起，再次避开撞来的头颅后，身在半空的他，右手一挥，顿时黑色铁签出现。
低头间，他目中杀机一闪，身体向下重重一沉，借助自己的力气与速度，还有体重，使铁签的冲击力达到极致，顺着此蛇的心脏区域，狠狠刺去。
碎开蛇鳞，势如破竹，一击刺入。
轰的一声，这巨角蟒全身强烈震颤，仿佛没有了支撑身体的力量，首尾重重落地，凄厉之嘶也在这一瞬戛然而止，唯有尾巴在地面无力拍打的声音传遍四周。
半晌后……随着尘土的消散，周围观望这一战的拾荒者，纷纷吃惊。
不少人都站了起身，一个个凝重的看着斗兽场内，此刻正从蛇尸上抽出铁签的少年。
若是成年人如此斩杀巨角蟒，不会让他们这般神情。
可一个看起来瘦瘦小小的小孩，能如此干净利落活蛇取胆吞下，又一击斩杀，且神色冷漠，从始至终没有丝毫变化。
这在营地里，极为少见。
一旁牢笼内那只小狼以及红熊，显然也都被吓到，此刻在那里瑟瑟发抖。
这似乎不是一场试炼，而是狩猎。
在四周众人的凝望下，少年将铁签放好，一只手扣住巨角蟒的伤口，向着斗兽场的大门走去。
他的身后，来自巨角蟒的鲜血，被拖出了一条红线，触目惊心。
大门旁，巨门还没有开启，许青回头看向高台。
不多时，高台上的三撇胡才反应过来，带着一些余悸，立刻打出手势，很快……大门轰轰声中开启。
露出了门外，双手抱胸靠着墙壁上，等待已久的雷队。
他笑着看向许青。
“我可以住你那里了么？”许青拖着蛇尸，抬头望着雷队。
“可以。”雷队笑道。
许青点了点头，将手中的蛇尸扔了过去。

“你喜欢吃蛇，这个请你吃。”
雷队一怔，随后哈哈大笑，接过巨角蟒尸，在这笑声中，带着许青，渐渐远去。
直至他们走远，斗兽场内才传出沸腾的哗然声。
而在这沸扬中，人群里角落中，有一个身穿紫色长袍的老者，身边跟着一个好似仆从般面无表情的中年，这中年的眉心，有一个五角星的图腾。
他们坐在那里，明明无论衣着还是气度，都与四周的环境格格不入，但似乎没有人能看见他们存在。
即便是营主，眼睛里，也都没有他们的身影。
那老者面色红润，目中竟有雷霆蕴含，仿佛外散便可毁灭一切，整个人极为不凡，此刻他坐在那里，望着许青远去的身影，忍不住笑了起来。
“这少年，有趣。”
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 7 Please eat
While Xu Qing was observing the environment of the fighting area, following the roar from the spectator seats, a huge wooden door fell down with a bang at the gate that Xu Qing and his party had just passed through.
It hit the ground hard, sending up dust.
This sound was like blowing a horn, making the scavengers around even more excited.
Xu Qing even noticed that on the top platform directly in front of him, there was a middle-aged man wearing a brocade robe, sitting at the top, accompanied by a group of people.
Because of the distance, it looks a little blurry.
But obviously this person's identity is unusual.
From such a distance, Xu Qing could feel that the spiritual energy fluctuations on the other party were extremely strong, beyond anything he had ever seen.
This made Xu Qing vigilant and at the same time, he also began to speculate in his heart that this person was most likely the owner of this camp.
Because next to the other party, Xu Qing saw the three-handed Hu Zheng from yesterday, leaning forward and seeming to be reporting carefully.
As the camp leader took his seat, the three-haired man stood on the high platform and gestured downwards.
Soon, another wooden door opened at the edge of the Colosseum, and the roars and roars of ferocious beasts could be heard more clearly without the obstruction of the wooden door.
What appeared with the sound was a group of scavengers.
They were divided into four teams, each with three people, each carrying a huge iron cage and slowly walked out.
Inside the iron cage, the ferocious beast roared and jumped around, as if it wanted to tear open the cage.
Xu Qing looked quickly and scanned the four iron cages.
I saw two giant wolves inside, one big and one small, but both had sharp teeth, their bodies were dark, and their eyes were bloody.
There was even a lot of saliva flowing from the corners of his mouth, and when he looked at Xu Qing and the other five people, they all showed ferocious intent.
There is also a red bear with red hair, its thick arms are longer than the thighs of an adult, its expression is full of rage, and it is constantly shaking the iron cage.
The three scavengers who carried it had great difficulty.
As for the ferocious beast in the last iron cage, it is obviously much weaker in momentum.
That's a gibbon.
The whole body was covered with pustules, which seemed to explode at the slightest touch. It seemed to be very painful, and it kept hitting the iron cage, causing the pustules to break apart, which was shocking.
Their appearance made the surrounding audience excited again.
The faces of the two teenagers beside Xu Qing instantly turned pale, and the little girl's eyes were also full of fear. Even the young man who was a scavenger was obviously a lot nervous at this moment.
"Why four?" Xu Qing was surprised and looked at the open wooden door passage.
The moment he looked, the four roaring and struggling ferocious beasts suddenly became silent for an instant, as if they were frightened.
At the same time, a huge iron cage that was nearly twice the size of the cage they were in was slowly lifted out of the wooden door by six scavengers.
As the iron cage appeared, some people in the surrounding audience suddenly exclaimed.
"Horned Python!!"
"This time the camp owner actually got a giant horned python, but in the eyes of the camp owner, this thing is not a valuable thing."
"For these little bastards, whoever gets this thing will die. Even if we encounter it in the wild, it will take two people to kill it."
The ferocious beast inside the iron cage was a huge python.
Its body is as thick as an adult's waist, and its body is gray and black with dark lines. If you look closely, the dark lines seem to depict horn-like peaks.
It coiled motionless in the cage, its huge head slightly raised, and its yellow vertical pupils looked coldly at the outside world.
Under its gaze, both the giant wolf and the gibbon were trembling.
Only the red bear let out a low growl when it was stimulated. It seemed to be fighting, but in fact its body was slowly retreating until it reached the edge of the cage.
"Don't get it, don't get it..."
Behind Xu Qing, the two young men were trembling and praying in low voices. Xu QingThere was a gleam in his eyes.
He knew about this giant horned python. When he was in the slums, he saw someone in the city hunting this python and bringing back its corpse.
At that time, I also heard from people with rich experience that this python is very strong. Once entangled by it, the giant tree will be strangled by it, and the python's skin is very thick.
But the body is clumsy and the speed is relatively slow.
Its gallbladder has very good medicinal properties and can resolve pollution in the body to a certain extent. At the same time, snake meat is also very nourishing.
Thinking of this, Xu Qing remembered that Lei Dui once said that he likes to eat snakes.
As for snakes, he had caught a lot of them when he was a child, so he licked his lips.
In addition, the alienation points on his body became darker and darker as he practiced, and he felt a faint tingling sensation during his practice yesterday.
Xu Qing thought that if he could eat the python's guts, he would be able to resolve a lot of problems.
As he stared at the horned python, the lottery began.
As the scavengers arranged by Sanbihu came over with five bamboo sticks, each bamboo stick was marked with the name of the vicious beast that needed to be fought.
The young man was the first to step forward and draw something. After seeing what he had drawn, he was obviously relieved.
Then came the two boys and the little girl.
The first two looked a little bitter after pulling out the bamboo sticks during prayer, but the little girl looked at the bamboo sticks in her hands with despair in her eyes.
The one she drew was the giant horned python, and the last bamboo stick left was the little wolf, which was also the obviously weakest of the five ferocious beasts.
Xu Qing held the bamboo stick, frowned slightly, and pondered.
Soon, after the scavengers retreated and the testers were placed in a corner and briefly stopped, the first test began amid the cheers of the spectators around them.
The person who arranged to appear was one of the two teenagers.
He walked out shivering, and the ferocious beast he fought with was the thick red bear.
The battle progressed very quickly. The boy was no match for the red bear. After struggling several times, he was knocked down by the red bear. In desperation, his body was torn apart.
Blood splattered everywhere, ushering in the boiling surroundings, accompanied by regretful curses.
This scene frightened the other boy so much that his body trembled. He who was supposed to be the second one suddenly shouted that he wanted to give up the trial.
So Xu Qing watched the young man being taken away by scavengers amidst boos. He didn't know what the outcome would be.
The third one is the young man who is a scavenger.
The one he drew was the larger black wolf. His experience as a scavenger made him more ruthless than ordinary people.
After a thrilling life-and-death struggle, he was wounded and panting and beheaded the wolf, becoming the first person to succeed in this trial.
The door opened, he clutched his chest and left freely.
The fourth...is a little girl.

But at this moment, Xu Qing suddenly spoke.
"Let's change."
The little girl was stunned for a moment, but before she could react, Xu Qing had already replaced her bamboo stick with it.
After taking away the bamboo stick with the horned python engraved on it, he ignored the little girl's grateful gaze and walked towards the horned python.
As they entered, the scavengers watching around them, who had obviously seen the order before, started to boo at this moment.
But except for those who bet on him and the little girl, no one else will care about this kind of thing. They won't, and neither will the camp owner. Everything will fend for itself.
In the Colosseum, Xu Qing walked calmly towards the iron cage. The giant horned python inside looked at Xu Qing coldly and slowly climbed out.
When the thick body leaned out of the iron cage, the scales scratched the iron bars of the cage, making bursts of harsh friction sounds.
The animal's instinct made it realize that the young man in front of it was somewhat different from the prey it usually encountered.
So after crawling out, the giant horned python did not attack immediately. Instead, it formed a formation outside the iron cage, with its head raised high and wary, staring at Xu Qing, who was approaching.
This scene aroused great interest in the surrounding audience, and there were few boos.Some.
Xu Qing's expression was as usual, and he was approaching step by step. Perhaps he had entered the attack range of the giant horned python, or maybe he was stimulated by his breath. The cold meaning in the vertical yellow pupils of the giant horned python was suddenly strong, and its tail slammed on the ground, making a roaring sound.
In response to this sound, his body rushed out violently, its mouth opened in mid-air, its sharp teeth exposed ferociously, and it emitted an unpleasant stench, roaring towards Xu Qing, intending to devour him.
Xu Qing narrowed his eyes and looked coldly at the giant horned python that was approaching rapidly. The moment the opponent approached, he swerved to avoid it. He did not choose to take advantage of the opportunity to take action, nor did he pay attention to the huge python head passing by. Instead, he showed his sharp eyes and closely observed the belly of the python like a hunter.
During his observation, the giant horned python jumped into the air, roared from its mouth, twisted its body, and suddenly swung its tail behind, making a harsh whistling sound, and fiercely lashed towards Xu Qing.
The hunting instinct made the horned python's head forcefully turn at this moment, and its tail moved forward and backward, like a circle that was about to be connected, and headed straight towards Xu Qing, as if it wanted to entangle him.
Xu Qing remained silent, his eyes still observing the giant horned python's abdomen until the snake's tail approached. He suddenly made a fist with his right hand and punched the snake's tail the moment it came out.
Although the practice of Haishan Jue was only one level, it still gave Xu Qing a lot of physical blessings. At this moment, the snake's tail was bombarded and rolled back, making it impossible to connect the head and tail. The giant horned python was obviously in pain, but this non-fatal injury made it fierce. With red eyes, it hit its head hard and bit Xu Qing.
But Xu Qing's eyes were focused, and something shone brightly. He finally found the place he was looking for. At this moment, his body stepped forward, not retreating but advancing, directly approaching the middle and upper area of ​​the giant horned python's body.
Make a fist with your right hand and punch hard, one punch, two punches, three punches...
Punch bombardment.
The impact from Xu Qing made the giant horned python continue to retreat, its roar became more intense, and it tried to wrap around Xu Qing, but the power contained in Xu Qing's fist made it difficult to touch its head and tail.
As for the bombarded abdomen, because its scales were relatively weak, after a few punches, it was somewhat shattered by Xu Qing's punches, blood oozed out, and its toughness was damaged.
Seeing this, Xu Qing's eyes flashed with coldness before the giant horned python could change its shape.
He immediately took out the dagger tied to his calf with his left hand, and with the cold light of the dagger shining, it pierced directly into the flesh and blood of the horned python with great speed.
It breaks in instantly and cuts hard.
Blood splashed everywhere, and amid the giant horned python's shrill hiss, a shocking wound was opened on its abdomen, revealing the snake gallbladder in its cavity.
This snake is very big, but it is obviously mutated. The snake's courage is as small as an egg.
Xu Qing didn't hesitate at all. He raised his right hand and penetrated deep into the cavity, grabbed the snake's gallbladder and pulled it hard. Amidst the giant horned python's shrill roar, he took out the snake's gallbladder.
Blood sprayed and sand fell.
Ignoring the bloodstains, Xu Qing took the snake gall and put it in his mouth in front of the scavengers with different expressions in his eyes, and swallowed it in one gulp.
While swallowing calmly, the horned python that had been gutted alive struggled wildly in pain, roared shrilly, and slapped its body hard on the ground to stir up dust, as if it wanted to vent the severe pain.
The head slammed towards Xu Qing even more violently, his red eyes showed madness, and his mouth opened to the extreme, as if he wanted to swallow Xu Qing completely.
Xu Qing looked coldly. The moment the opponent approached, his body suddenly jumped up. After avoiding the head collision again, he was in mid-air and waved his right hand, and a black iron sign suddenly appeared.
As he lowered his head, murderous intent flashed in his eyes, and his body sank heavily downward. Using his own strength, speed, and weight, he maximized the impact of the iron stick and stabbed it hard along the snake's heart area.
Breaking open the snake's scales, it was as powerful as a broken bamboo and penetrated with one blow.
With a bang, the giant horned python's whole body trembled violently, as if it had no support.With the power of his body, he landed heavily on his head and tail, and his shrill screams stopped abruptly at this moment. Only the sound of his tail flapping feebly on the ground spread around.
After a while... as the dust dissipated, the scavengers watching the battle were all surprised.
Many people stood up and looked solemnly at the young man who was pulling out the iron stick from the snake corpse in the Colosseum.
If adults killed the horned python like this, they would not look like this.
But a small and skinny child could so cleanly swallow the bile of a live snake and kill it with one blow, and his expression was indifferent, without any change from the beginning to the end.
This is extremely rare in the camp.
The little wolf and the red bear in the cage on the side were obviously frightened, and were trembling there.
This doesn't seem to be a trial, but a hunt.
Under the gaze of everyone around him, the young man put the iron stick in place, clasped the giant horned python's wound with one hand, and walked towards the gate of the Colosseum.
Behind him, the blood from the horned python was dragged out of a red line, which was shocking.
Next to the gate, the giant gate has not yet opened, Xu Qing turned back to look at the high platform.
Not long after, the three-haired man on the high platform realized what he was doing. With some lingering fear, he immediately made a gesture, and soon... the door opened with a roar.
Exposed outside the door, leaning against the wall with his arms folded, Team Lei had been waiting for a long time.
He looked at Xu Qing with a smile.
"Can I stay at your place?" Xu Qing dragged the snake corpse and looked up at Team Lei.
"Okay." Captain Lei smiled.
Xu Qing nodded and threw the snake corpse in his hand.
"You like to eat snakes, please eat this."
Captain Lei was startled for a moment, then he laughed loudly, took the giant horned python corpse, and in this laughter, he took Xu Qing and gradually walked away.
It wasn't until they were far away that boiling uproar came from the Colosseum.
And in the midst of this uproar, in the corner of the crowd, there was an old man wearing a purple robe, followed by a middle-aged man with an expressionless face like a servant. This middle-aged man had a five-pointed star totem between his eyebrows.
They were sitting there, obviously incompatible with the surrounding environment in terms of their clothes and demeanor, but no one seemed to be able to see their existence.
Even the camp owner didn't see them in his eyes.
The old man's face was ruddy, and there was thunder in his eyes, as if it could destroy everything if it spread out. He was extremely extraordinary. At this moment, he was sitting there, looking at Xu Qing's retreating figure, and couldn't help but laugh.
"This boy is interesting."
